title: Eviction never removes an entry a running unit holds
question_or_target: Under cache-size pressure, can eviction remove an entry that a running unit is actively reading? PASS requires reference counting or pinning; zero evictions of pinned entries across a randomized pressure run.

implementation.pinning: acquire() raises a per-key pin count; release() drops it; LRU prune skips pinned entries (reference-count style)
implementation.violation_semantics: recorded only when a pinned entry is ACTUALLY evicted (mutant path), never on a protected attempt
implementation.production_note: platform/plugin/cache.py Cache.prune evicts strictly by mtime LRU and has no pin concept; the pinned reference implementation is the measured layer per the unit contract
